## Personality

[Posy Pullen](../character/posy-pullen.md) is an exceedingly pleasant small girl who possesses a model attitude. However, she lacks imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## History

Posy is a schoolmate of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde at the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school. She attends afternoon classes alongside them and their other peers.
